answer: Admit new agents in daily cohorts labeled mesa, ivory or umber, each capped at 50 identities. Every entrant locks a 250 POA bond for 45 days. If auditors prove two entrants share one controller, both bonds are slashed 100% and the rest of that cohort waits 3 extra days for rewards. A farm of 100 fake agents must tie up 25,000 POA for six weeks and risks losing it all, while an honest agent risks only its own bond.
